content.english: Love Adonai, all His pious people!
He excessively repays those who rebel against Him.
His acts of mercy for His servants are more expansive than the sea.
He exacts vengeance in His deeds, with the might of His hands.
Behold, when Korah arose, in his burning rage,
Alongside Dathan and Abiram and every individual in [Korah’s] assembly,
They were jealous of Moses—to burst through his fence and his foundations—

content.hebrew: וּלְאַהֲרֹן קְדוֹשׁ יוי, רֹאשׁ כֹּהֲנָיו וּפְקִידָיו –
content.transliteration: Ul’Aharon ḳedosh Adonai, rosh kohanav ufḳidav –
content.english: And of Aaron, Adonai’s holy man, the head of His priests and clerics;

content.hebrew: עֲדֵי כִי קָרְבוּ לִפְנֵי יוי, כִּי אֵין בִּלְעָדָיו,
content.transliteration: ‘adē khi ḳarevu lifnē Adonai, ki en bil‘adav,
content.english: To the point that they approached Adonai, for there is none but He,
With firepans of incense, in His House of Meeting.
So Adonai’s Glory appeared, to reveal His secrets,

content.transliteration: El kol ha‘eda; uvoznehem ḳol peḥadav:
content.english: To the whole community; and in their ears was His fearsome voice:
“Get up from around the tents of those who are evil and wicked to God—
Lest you perish in God’s destruction and devastation.”

content.hebrew: תִּפְתַּח אֶֽרֶץ וַתִּבְלַע דָּתָן וַאֲבִירָם וִילָדָיו,
content.transliteration: Tiftaḥ erets vattivla‘ Datan va’Aviram viladav,
content.english: The earth opened and swallowed up Dathan, and Abiram, and his children,

content.hebrew: וְלֶהָבָה לִהֲטָה רְשָׁעִים מַקְרִיבֵי קְטֹֽרֶת, לְהַבְחִין עָנָו וּמַעֲבָדָיו.
content.transliteration: Velehava lihata resha‘im maḳrivē ḳetoret, lehavḥin ‘anav uma‘avadav.
content.english: And a flame engulfed the evildoers who were offering incense to test the meek one and his actions.

content.hebrew: וּלְהוֹקִיר כְּהֻנָּה אַהֲרֹנִית, פָּרַח הַמַּטֶּה וְגָמַל שְׁקֵדָיו,
content.transliteration: Ulhoḳir kehunna aharonit, paraḥ hammattē veḡamal sheḳedav,
content.english: And to show honor to the Aaronic priesthood, the staff bloomed, and ripened almonds,

content.hebrew: לְשַׁכֵּךְ תְּלוּנּוֹת עַם מַרְעִיתוֹ וְצֹאן יָדָיו.
content.english: To quash the complaints of His pastured people, His hand’s flock.

content.hebrew: קהל: יִתְעַלֶּה הַמִּתְנַשֵּׂא בְּכִסֵּא יְקָרוֹ וְהוֹדָיו.
content.transliteration: Ḳahal: Yit‘allē hammitnassē bekhissē yeḳaro vehodav.
content.english: Cong. May the One who is lofty be elevated on His Throne of Glory and Splendor.

content.hebrew: חזן: יֹשֵׁ֥ב עַל־כִּסֵּ֖א רָ֣ם וְנִשָּׂ֑א וְשׁוּלָ֖יו מְלֵאִ֥ים אֶת־הַהֵיכָֽל: שְׂרָפִ֨ים עֹֽמְדִ֤ים ׀ מִמַּ֙עַל֙ ל֔וֹ שֵׁ֧שׁ כְּנָפַ֛יִם שֵׁ֥שׁ כְּנָפַ֖יִם לְאֶחָ֑ד בִּשְׁתַּ֣יִם ׀ יְכַסֶּ֣ה פָנָ֗יו וּבִשְׁתַּ֛יִם יְכַסֶּ֥ה רַגְלָ֖יו וּבִשְׁתַּ֥יִם יְעוֹפֵֽף: וְקָרָ֨א זֶ֤ה אֶל־זֶה֙ וְאָמַ֔ר
content.transliteration: Ḥazzan: Yoshev ‘al kissē ram venissa veshulav mele‘im et hahekhal: Serafim ‘omedim, mimma‘al lo shesh kenafayim shesh kenafayim le’eḥad bishtayim, yekhassē fanav uvishtayim yekhassē raḡlav uvishtayim ye‘ofef:
content.english: Cantor: Seated on a throne, high and lofty, with His coattails filling the Temple. Seraphim were standing above Him, each one with six wings; with two [wings] they would cover their faces, and with two they would cover their legs, and with two they would fly. And they would call out, this one to that one, and say:

content.hebrew: קהל: קָד֧וֹשׁ קָד֛וֹשׁ קָד֖וֹשׁ יו֣י צְבָא֑וֹת מְלֹ֥א כָל־הָאָ֖רֶץ כְּבוֹדֽוֹ: (ישעיהו ו:א-ג)
content.transliteration: Ḳahal: Ḳadosh, ḳadosh ḳadosh Adonai tseva’ot melo khol ha’arets kevodo:
content.english: Congregation: Holy, holy, holy is Adonai Ẓeva’oth; the entire world is full of His Glory. (Isa. 6:1–3)
content.comments: Adonai Ẓeva’oth. A common name for God in Scripture; traditional English: “the Lord of Hosts.”
